c447708c0a2c7b78.description: About the Role Carrier is seeking a Senior Chiller Technician to join their team. This full-time role involves performing maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and overhaul of HVAC and chiller systems. The successful candidate will ensure reliable equipment performance, high-quality service delivery, and compliance with company procedures, manufacturer guidelines, and Environmental, Health & Safety (EH&S) requirements. Role Overview The Senior Chiller Technician will apply strong technical expertise in chiller systems, communicate effectively with customers, and work both independently and collaboratively to deliver service. This position requires maintaining high standards of safety, quality, and professionalism, including identifying and mitigating work-related hazards, complying with Carrier policies, maintaining accurate service records, and ensuring all work meets applicable standards and customer requirements. Key Responsibilities Perform scheduled preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and overhaul of chillers and associated HVAC equipment according to manufacturer guidelines and industry standards. Inspect air-conditioning and chiller systems, diagnose mechanical and electrical faults, and recommend corrective actions. Maintain, adjust, and repair electrical and electronic control systems, motors, pumps, blowers, coils, belts, and other equipment components. Repair or replace damaged parts to ensure efficient and reliable equipment operation. Conduct site inspections and prepare technical reports detailing site conditions, scope of work, findings, and recommendations. Estimate labor hours, materials, and tools required for assigned jobs. Complete job cards, job completion certificates, daily timesheets, maintenance records, and EH&S site survey documentation accurately and on time. Communicate with customers regarding work progress, outstanding issues, and recommended corrective actions or improvements. Complete assigned tasks within agreed timelines while maintaining service quality, customer satisfaction, and an organized worksite. Identify potential safety risks and implement appropriate control measures before and during work activities. Safely rig and set up gantries and lifting equipment for handling heavy machinery, including chillers and pumps, in accordance with approved procedures. Manage and maintain tools and equipment, including collection, delivery, proper use, and inventory control. Adhere to company processes, quality management standards, EH&S procedures, and applicable manufacturer requirements. Escalate technical issues, safety concerns, and resource requirements to the Supervisor or Manager as needed. Collaborate effectively with colleagues and other teams to ensure efficient service delivery. Attend technical training sessions, EH&S meetings, and other assigned training programs. Perform additional duties and responsibilities as required. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in chiller systems and HVAC maintenance. Demonstrated technical expertise in diagnosing and repairing mechanical and electrical faults in chiller and HVAC equipment. Ability to interpret manufacturer guidelines and industry standards. Required Skills Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic abilities. Effective communication skills for customer interaction. Proficiency in preparing technical reports and documentation. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Commitment to safety protocols and quality standards. Work Type This is a full-time position.

c44b2b9114fdd9e0.description: About Informa PLC and Tahaluf Informa PLC is a global leader in events and digital services. Tahaluf, a joint venture between Informa PLC, the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP), and the Events Investment Fund (EIF), operates as the largest B2B live and on-demand events organizer in Saudi Arabia. Tahaluf is known for organizing large-scale events such as LEAP, Cityscape, Black Hat MEA, and CPHI Middle East, contributing significantly to the global events sector. About LIONS Riyadh LIONS Riyadh is a new festival launched by Tahaluf in partnership with LIONS and Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Media. This distinct Festival within the global LIONS community aims to highlight Middle Eastern creativity on a global platform, showcasing regional talent and connecting creative industries with leading networks and brands. The inaugural three-day Festival is scheduled to take place at KAFD, Riyadh, from December 6–8, 2027, bringing together CMOs, creative leaders, agencies, and emerging talent. The Role: Senior Conference Producer - LIONS Riyadh Tahaluf is seeking a Senior Conference Producer for LIONS Riyadh. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, requires an Arabic speaker with 5-10 years of experience. The Senior Conference Producer will be responsible for developing and delivering the content program for LIONS Riyadh, focusing on original, relevant, and culturally resonant sessions that address current trends in creativity, marketing, media, technology, and culture. The role demands strong editorial judgment, an understanding of the creative and marketing industries, and organizational skills to manage multiple sessions, speakers, and deadlines. Key Responsibilities Produce high-level, industry-relevant conference programs. Research, develop, and write compelling session content across various industry domains. Liaise with key professionals, institutions, and companies to develop conference programs. Identify, engage, and confirm high-quality global, Saudi, and regional speakers. Maintain and update the speaker database with accurate information. Prepare and communicate creative briefs to the Marketing team. Develop detailed speaker briefs, session narratives, and moderator guidance to ensure content quality. Assist Commercial and Partnerships teams with relevant leads and opportunities. Mentor other conference producers within the team. Collaborate with the Head of Content to maintain editorial quality and consistency. Conduct post-Festival analysis, including session performance and audience feedback. Research topics with industry professionals and target audiences. Develop new program ideas and content through meetings, interviews, and industry research. Stay informed on developments across advertising, marketing, media, technology, entertainment, culture, and the creator economy. Identify emerging ideas, talent, and trends for program opportunities. Identify key opinion leaders, organizations, and companies relevant to the Festival. Maintain existing relationships and build new industry relationships to support program development. Develop new content formats, including masterclasses, debates, workshops, and live case studies. Ensure a balance of global, Saudi, and regional voices across the program. Liaise and network with speakers, partners, and delegates onsite to maintain service standards and gather feedback. Assist with onsite duties during the Festival, including extended working hours. Manage speaker preparation, briefing, and onsite experience. Support stage delivery and order of show, working with production and operations teams. Build long-term relationships with priority speakers and industry contributors for future editions. Qualifications and Experience Degree level education or equivalent. A degree or professional background in media, marketing, communications, journalism, creative industries, or a related field is preferred. Relevant content or editorial experience may be considered in place of formal qualifications. 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Fluency in Arabic is required.

c4ddac3b010af624.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة القسي العالمية للمقاولات عن مهندس كهروميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتصميم الأنظمة والمعدات الكهروميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى الإشراف على الجوانب التقنية للإنتاج والتركيب والصيانة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم المعدات والأنظمة الكهروميكانيكية، وتحديد معايير الأداء والجودة المطلوبة. إدارة عمليات تركيب المعدات والأنظمة، بما في ذلك إعداد الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. الإشراف المباشر على أعمال صيانة المعدات وتصليحها لضمان استمرارية التشغيل. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال الكهروميكانيكي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة، والمشاركة في عرضها وتوضيحها، والعمل على حفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهروميكانيكية. فهم عميق لمبادئ تصميم وتشغيل الأنظمة الكهروميكانيكية. القدرة على تقديم المشورة الفنية بشأن المواد والتقنيات المستخدمة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التصميم الهندسي والتحليل الفني. القدرة على إدارة المشاريع والإشراف على فرق العمل. مهارات قوية في إعداد التقارير الفنية والتوثيق. القدرة على التكيف مع التطورات التقنية المستمرة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة القسي العالمية للمقاولات في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الكهروميكانيكيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقديم.

c4bb0aac855055a8.description: Job description Sr. Manager, Gross-to-Net Commercial Excellence Department: Commercial Excellence, International Operations Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Your impact begins here As Sr. Manager, Gross-to-Net Commercial Excellence, you will drive how Novo Saudi Arabia plans, manage and evaluates its commercial investments. You will own Gross-to-Net management, turn performance data into forward-looking recommendations and help leadership decide where investment creates the most value. Your work supports sustainable, profitable growth in Saudi Arabia, so we can keep serving people living with serious chronic diseases. What you’ll bring You combine commercial and financial insight with the discipline to turn complex data into clear decisions. A Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Pharmacy, Engineering or another relevant discipline. At least 7 years of relevant experience in consumer health, pharmaceutical or FMCG companies. At least 3 years in Gross-to-Net or net revenue management, Pricing, Commercial Excellence, Commercial Finance, Trade or Channel Strategy, Business Planning or a closely related area. A strong understanding of the gross-to-net and net revenue waterfall, including discounts, rebates, trade investments, accruals, price-volume-mix and net sales drivers. Advanced analytical, modelling, forecasting and scenario-planning skills, including advanced Excel and experience with Power BI or a similar visualisation tool. Experience leading cross-functional governance, performance-management or forecasting processes and engaging senior stakeholders. The ability to influence and lead without formal authority, with excellent communication, facilitation and presentation skills. Fluent written and spoken English. High integrity, sound judgement, attention to detail and a continuous-improvement mindset. Useful, but not essential: Experience in the Saudi retail pharmacy market is highly preferred. Arabic proficiency. An MBA or other relevant postgraduate qualification. What you’ll do You will be the owner of Gross-to-Net management in Saudi Arabia, while collaborating with the Commercial Excellence lead for performance analysis, planning and forecasting. Own and improve the end-to-end Gross-to-Net governance cycle, including calendar, data inputs, definitions, roles, decision rights, review forums and action tracking. Build and maintain one transparent Gross-to-Net waterfall across discounts, rebates, trade investments, marketing funding and other commercial deductions, with visibility by product, customer, channel and investment type. Lead regular reviews with Trade, Pricing, Marketing and Finance: reconcile actuals against plan and forecast, challenge assumptions and variances, and track actions to closure. Make sure every Gross-to-Net element has a clear objective, eligibility criteria, approval route and measurable outcome, and monitor exceptions, policy adherence and total exposure. Identify revenue leakage, over- or under-spend and ineffective investments, and recommend corrective actions, reallocation and performance-based alternatives for leadership reviews, key customer decisions and commercial negotiations. With the Commercial Excellence lead, develop dashboards and scorecards, run driver, variance and scenario analyses, and contribute to annual planning, target setting and rolling forecasts that bring volume, price, mix and Gross-to-Net assumptions into one net sales outlook. Improve data quality, dashboards and automation, and manage consultancies, agencies and data providers as required, always in line with internal controls, local requirements and business ethics. Who you’ll work with Based in Riyadh, you will join the Commercial Excellence department in Saudi Arabia, part of International Operations, and report to the Director, CE & Projects – Saudi Arabia. Y Day to day, you will work with the Saudi Leadership Team and with colleagues in Commercial excellence, Trade, Marketing, Pricing & Market Access, Finance, Sales and Supply Chain. You will also connect with Regional and International Operations teams in Gross-to-Net, pricing, commercial insights and Analytics, and with external consultancies, agencies and data providers when needed. Much of this work happens without direct authority. You will bring different functions together, speak up when things stall and keep decisions moving with clear owners and deadlines. What you can expect here You will work in an international environment where your expertise is valued and your recommendations reach senior leaders. The role gives you the chance to broaden your commercial and financial perspective by working across Trade, Pricing, Marketing, Finance and regional teams. You will be supported to perform at your best, trusted to take ownership and encouraged to make your voice heard. Expectations are clear, the pace is steady and the culture rewards results. Start now Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring clarity and discipline to commercial investment in Saudi Arabia, apply for the Sr. Manager, Gross-to-Net Commercial Excellence role by November 3, 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants. Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

c4e4edcdaf456439.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة عن كاتب موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في رابغ، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم الدعم الإداري والتشغيلي لقسم الموارد البشرية في مختلف الجوانب، بما في ذلك الاستقطاب، التهيئة، المزايا، علاقات الموظفين، السجلات، الرواتب، التدريب، والالتزام بالسياسات والأنظمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دعم عملية الإعلان عن الوظائف، فرز طلبات التوظيف، وتنسيق المقابلات الشخصية وعمليات التهيئة للموظفين الجدد. تحديث وحفظ بيانات الموظفين، المعلومات الوظيفية، وتقييمات الأداء بشكل دقيق ومنظم. تجميع ومراجعة سجلات الحضور، ساعات العمل الإضافي، والإجازات لدعم إعداد كشوف الرواتب. تنظيم برامج التدريب، توثيق الشهادات، وتحديد الاحتياجات التطويرية للموظفين. الرد على استفسارات الموظفين المتعلقة بالسياسات الداخلية، المزايا، والإجراءات المتبعة في الشركة. دعم الالتزام بنظام العمل المعمول به، وتحديث الوثائق والتقارير ذات الصلة. تقديم الدعم الإداري العام، بما في ذلك جدولة الاجتماعات وإعداد المراسلات الرسمية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الموارد البشرية أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تقديم الدعم الإداري والتشغيلي الفعال. مهارات تنظيمية وتواصل ممتازة. بيئة العمل يعمل كاتب الموارد البشرية ضمن فريق الموارد البشرية في شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة في مدينة رابغ، مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في مقر الشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

c4d171143bb8cc6e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة لها للياقة الرياضي عن مدرب لياقة بدنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتضمن هذا الدور العمل كمدرب شخصي ومدرب حصص جماعية في نادٍ رياضي نسائي، مع التركيز على تصميم برامج تدريبية مخصصة ومتابعة تقدم المتدربات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع خطط تمارين فردية تتناسب مع مستوى كل متدربة وأهدافها. تصميم برامج تدريبية تهدف إلى خفض الدهون، شد الجسم، وزيادة القوة واللياقة البدنية. تحديد عدد التمارين والتكرارات ومدة التدريب لكل متدربة. شرح التمارين وتوضيح الطريقة الصحيحة لأدائها لضمان الفعالية والسلامة. تصحيح وضعية الجسم والحركة أثناء التمرين لتقليل خطر الإصابات. متابعة استخدام الأجهزة والأوزان بشكل آمن وفعال. تقديم التدريب للمجموعات أو المتدربات بشكل فردي. تقديم حصص الكارديو، تمارين المقاومة، المرونة، والتوازن. تنظيم الإحماء قبل التمرين والتهدئة بعده. تقييم مستوى اللياقة البدنية للمتدربات ضمن حدود التأهيل المهني. متابعة تطور القوة والتحمل والمرونة لدى المتدربات. تسجيل النتائج وتعديل البرنامج التدريبي بناءً على التقدم والاحتياجات. تشجيع المتدربات على الالتزام بالبرنامج والاستمرار في التدريب. تعزيز الثقة بالنفس ومساعدة المتدربات على تحقيق أهدافهن الواقعية. مراعاة الفروق الفردية والخصوصية وخلق بيئة تدريب مريحة وداعمة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال تدريب اللياقة البدنية. القدرة على تصميم وتنفيذ برامج تدريب شخصية وجماعية. معرفة بأساليب التدريب المختلفة مثل الكارديو، المقاومة، المرونة، والتوازن. بيئة العمل يعمل مدرب اللياقة البدنية بدوام كامل في نادٍ رياضي نسائي بالرياض، ضمن بيئة داعمة تهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف اللياقة البدنية للمتدربات. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. الراتب الراتب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

c41f7470616d24b9.description: Description The Operational Accountant is responsible for managing and recording daily financial transactions, controlling revenues and expenses, and linking operational activities with the accounting system. The role also involves preparing periodic financial reports and supporting management in decision-making. The role focuses on ensuring accurate financial tracking of operational activities, maintaining financial integrity, and supporting both accounting and operational processes. Responsibilities Record daily accounting entries (revenues, expenses, petty cash, advances) Match and reconcile daily revenues with POS reports and bank statements Follow up on collections (cash, bank transfers, POS) and ensure accuracy Manage petty cash and perform regular reconciliation Track and classify expenses according to approved categories Prepare monthly financial reports (income statement, revenue analysis, expense analysis) Review invoices and ensure compliance with VAT requirements Monitor prepaid expenses and allocate them correctly Contribute to inventory control and related financial movements Identify and resolve financial discrepancies promptly Work on accounting systems and ensure accurate and consistent data entry Prepare analytical reports to support management decision-making Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance Minimum 2 years of practical accounting experience Preferably experience with ERP systems and POS systems Good understanding of VAT regulations in Saudi Arabia Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel High attention to detail and accuracy Ability to organize work and manage time effectively Basic financial analysis skills Ability to detect and resolve errors Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines Must be currently based in Saudi Arabia Salary: 4,500 SAR (all-inclusive) Opportunity to work in a structured operational finance environment Exposure to accounting operations, reporting, and financial analysis Professional growth within a dynamic team

c47704b4b1825d67.description: JASARA PMC is seeking a highly experienced Procurement Lead to oversee and lead our procurement operations at a strategic level. This role involves providing leadership and direction to the procurement department while ensuring alignment with the organization's overall goals and project requirements. The Procurement Lead will drive procurement strategies, optimize supply chain efficiencies, and foster strong vendor relationships to support the successful delivery of Giga projects. Lead and manage the procurement function across multiple projects, ensuring compliance with company policies and industry standards. Develop and implement comprehensive procurement strategies that optimize cost, quality, and delivery timelines. Provide strategic direction and guidance to procurement teams to achieve operational excellence. Establish and maintain relationships with key suppliers and stakeholders. Oversee contract negotiations, ensuring favorable terms and risk mitigation. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align procurement activities with project objectives. Monitor procurement performance metrics and implement continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements related to procurement activities. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field. Over 15-18 years of progressive experience in procurement and supply chain management, with at least 5 years in a leadership or director-level role. Proven track record in managing procurement for large-scale infrastructure or construction projects. Strong negotiation, leadership, and strategic planning skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. Comprehensive knowledge of procurement laws, regulations, and best practices. Ability to lead and develop high-performing procurement teams. Experience with procurement software and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems.

c4f9299e76a30d5d.description: Eram Talent is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Administrative Assistant to support our operations. In this role, you will provide essential administrative support to ensure the efficiency of our office and the effectiveness of our team. As an Administrative Assistant, you will be responsible for various administrative tasks that contribute to the smooth running of the organization. Your responsibilities will include managing schedules, organizing files, preparing reports, and assisting in facilitating meetings and communications. The ideal candidate will thrive in a fast-paced environment, be a quick learner, and possess outstanding organizational and time management skills. Key Responsibilities Assist in daily office operations, including managing correspondence and scheduling meetings. Prepare and format documents, reports, and presentations as needed. Maintain organized filing systems and ensure documents are easily accessible. Coordinate meetings, including sending invitations, preparing agendas, and recording minutes. Act as a point of contact for internal and external communications. Assist with the preparation and coordination of company events and activities. Track office supplies and place orders as necessary to maintain inventory. Support team members with various administrative tasks as requested. High school diploma or equivalent; degree in business administration or a related field preferred. Minimum of 5 years of experience in an administrative or office support role. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize tasks effectively. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Detail-oriented with a commitment to delivering high-quality work. oil and Gas Experience. Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team. Experience in a fast-paced environment is advantageous.

c4e0fb13e4a22e29.job_title: Theme Park & Attractions Maintenance Training Course
c4e0fb13e4a22e29.description: The Theme Park & Attractions Maintenance programme is a comprehensive offering aimed at equipping participants with the necessary skills for maintaining safe and operational environments in visitor attractions. Participants will develop essential maintenance skills, including adherence to safety protocols, conducting routine inspections, and performing both preventive and corrective maintenance. The course covers the theoretical foundations of equipment safety, combined with hands-on technical training in ride maintenance and repair. Through a blend of classroom instruction, practical exercises, and case studies, participants will gain the confidence and expertise needed to maintain the safe and efficient operation of theme park attractions. Eligibility Criteria Nationality: Saudi National Education: Diploma or higher Degree Years of experience: Not applicable Availability: Full-time availability and commitment to attend the entire programme Required documents: CV
